Premise: holds — the console's 新建视图 writes through `createRuntimeMetadata` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/runtime-metadata-persistence.ts:351-367`, `metadataClient.save(type, name, body, { mode: 'draft' })`, no `packageId`), so the view is a package-less row, not an item of the base; the dev measures the served `_packageId` of such a view before choosing the fix

Prior rulings read: card + thread: 1 triage first touch (7016233676), no ruling. `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 35600 --paths StudioCustomizeControls.tsx,ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` → ADR-0146 D11, D2, D6, D1, D8, D3, D5, ADR-0061 D2, ADR-0150 D9; the 5 ⛔ lines read, none rules on which view is the base's. Binding: ADR-0146 D11 "A package-less row for an item **no** package ships is environment metadata, not an overlay, and is not touched"; ADR-0146 D2 (an override is a declaration of an item the base ships). Same-day churn 609b6751 — 基于合并后的代码工作,issue 引用的片段可能已变,先核对当前 main。
Serial constraints cleared: #34931 (area b1-U, claimed 7016077023, no PR yet) edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` DataPillar (`:6633`, `:7021`), far from the list-view block; overlap-check decides at push. The #35499 card thread (Studio form refused-save marking) works in `studio-design/` too, no PR yet.
Fold: runs alone — no open card shares the list-view Customize save path (#34908 keeps item 1, a Feature owing a scope review; #34931 is DataPillar's object save; #35499 is the form editor's refusal marking).
